newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Air France mulls raising ex-Nordic cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: Air France mulls raising ex-Nordic cargo capacity.

text.p: Air France said on Friday it would consider stepping up the frequency of its weekly Paris-Helsinki-Stockholm-Paris freighter operation.

"The one frequency we have had has been very successful. Obviously, at this time of the year we have been exploring the possibility to increase this frequency," Air France cargo manager Sweden Anders Forslund told Reuters.
"No decision has been made yet," he added.

Air France started the cargo operation with a Boeing 747-200F between Stockholm and Paris last October. In May it started a service from Paris to Helsinki but combined the flights due to a slowdown in volumes during the summer season.
